unsupported_action_responses.force_against_wall: The paneling shudders under the force, shedding a breath of plaster dust, but nothing opens or changes.
unsupported_action_responses.force_against_furniture: The furniture jolts under the impact and settles exactly where the room's reality permits it.
unsupported_action_responses.default: The action produces a visible but inconsequential disturbance and no useful change.

writing_desk.look_under: Dust softens the floor beneath the desk; no compartment or hidden object is present.
writing_desk.touch: The desk's scratched wood is dry and solid; the contact reveals nothing new.
writing_desk.knock: The desk answers with a dull wooden knock and no suggestion of a hidden compartment.
writing_desk.repeat: The already-searched wood offers no new evidence.

desk_drawers.read: The writing desk has decorative drawer fronts but no accessible drawers; the joinery declines further cross-examination.
desk_drawers.repeat: The writing desk has decorative drawer fronts but no accessible drawers; the joinery declines further cross-examination.

correspondence.read: The correspondence covers an academic dinner, a newspaper subscription, and an overdue reply; none bears on Callum's disappearance.
correspondence.smell: The correspondence smells faintly of paper and old ink, without any unusual chemical trace.

receipt.read: The receipt records two bottles of ink and an expensive lunch, with no coded notation or hidden message.
receipt.touch: The receipt is ordinary, dry paper; its texture supplies no hidden message.

paneled_wall.knock: The panel returns a solid, ordinary knock; there is no hollow passage behind this section.

rug.smell: The wool smells of dust, damp, and old smoke; the scent reveals nothing further.
rug.manipulate: The rug shifts easily. Beneath it are dusty boards and one bent tack, but no hidden compartment.

window_latch.inspect: The brass latch is cold, intact, and firmly seated.

fireplace.touch: The hearthstone is cold and lightly gritty with soot.

bookshelves.stare: The shelves endure the scrutiny with rows of ordinary reference works.

chair.look_under: Only dust lies beneath the chair; its upholstery has contributed nothing to the case.
chair.touch: The chair's worn upholstery gives slightly under your hand and reveals nothing concealed.
chair.smell: The chair smells of dust and old upholstery. It has no further statement to make.

large_painting.stare: The painting remains stubbornly inanimate under sustained scrutiny.
large_painting.repeat: The shifted painting remains a painting, now less successful at concealing the safe.

guillermo.ask: Guillermo looks at Armand, considers the question, and answers with a small, noncommittal shrug.
guillermo.gesture: Guillermo's head snaps toward the whistle. He gives one tiny, solemn wave back, then returns his attention to the desk as though the exchange had been official business.
